items.title: Suspected plague outbreak in Russia: public health risk lower than Covid-19
items.summary: Despite concern, Y. pestis has a lower rate of transmission than coronavirus, as well being a more studied pathogen.

items.title: CAR-T specialist Caribou culls pipeline and seeks exit deal
items.summary: Despite Nobel Prize origins, Caribou has succumbed to a sector shifting its focus to in vivo CAR-T approaches.

items.title: CPHI 2026: Moderna builds on its COVID-era manufacturing lessons
items.summary: The biotech’s VP of Drug Product Operations Michelle Rodriguez on how it works with CDMOs.

items.title: KymaThera pulls in $80m to bring breast cancer drug to clinic
items.summary: KymaThera plans to dose the first patients in its Phase I trial on oral, selective PI3Kα inhibitor, K-1728, in breast cancer in Q4 2026.

items.title: Rocket receives $150m credit facility to advance cardiovascular portfolio
items.summary: Rocket Pharmaceuticals has entered into a credit facility agreement of up to $150m with Hercules Capital to support the ongoing development of its cardiovascular portfolio.
